arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_amount_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE c.credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000
arguments.explanation: Adds up the amount of every transaction made on cards whose credit limit is above $20,000, and shows the total in dollars.
assumptions: $20,000 is 2,000,000 cents, and 'above' means strictly greater than.
All transactions are included, labelled or not, since the question does not mention fraud labels.
Negative amounts (56,900 rows, meaning undocumented) are included as recorded, so the total is net of them.
The total covers the whole data period, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
